# GoldAlert — Free Precious Metals Signal Dashboard

GoldAlert (https://goldalert.org/) is a free educational precious-metals dashboard. It combines provider-supplied live market context with scheduled daily closes used for transparent pullback signals, commodity dashboards and macro ratios.

## Core signal rule

- 0–2 consecutive lower daily closes: HOLD
- 3–4 consecutive lower daily closes: 50% BUY / WATCH
- 5 or more consecutive lower daily closes: 100% BUY / STRONG

These labels are rule stages, not probabilities, forecasts or individualized position-size recommendations.

- https://goldalert.org/ratios/ — Gold/Silver, Gold/Oil, Bitcoin/Gold, Gold/Copper and Gold/Platinum ratios

## Editorial scope

GoldAlert publishes rule-based signals and educational content about precious metals, commodities and macro ratios. It does not provide personalized financial advice. All signal rules are transparent and documented at https://goldalert.org/methodology.html.

## Data sources

Daily close prices: Yahoo Finance and CoinGecko for supported cryptoassets. Charts: TradingView widgets. Signals are generated from historical daily closes only. If a provider is unavailable, GoldAlert should show unavailable or retain the latest dated close rather than invent a replacement value.
